Fudbalski klub Sutjeska is a professional association football club from Nikšić, Montenegro, currently competing in the Montenegrin First League. The club was established in 1920, and has been known by its current name since 1945. Since the Montenegrin independence in 2006, the club has won 6 First League titles. FK Sutjeska Nikšić is a part of the Sutjeska Sports Society.
